title: Tibble Extension for Nowcasts
text: Traditionally epidemiological nowcasting scenarios two dates: event_date: something happened (e.g. symptom onset test taken). report_date: reported (e.g. patient went clinic test results registered). nowcasting problem estimate total number events now occurred past event_date given reported yet.

title: Tibble Extension for Nowcasts
text: context nowcasting, tbl_now can thought specific tibble() guarantees event_date report_date. example following data.frame represents number cases n reported report_date happened event_date convert tbl_now can use tbl_now() function: tbl_now() automatically detects whether data-type corresponds linelist, count-incidence count-cumulative data, date-units event report dates (frequency), now given latest date (2023-12-27). Additionally transforms event_date numeric (.event_num column) well report_date (.report_num column) calculates delay (.delay column). tbl_now() compatible usual dplyr operations adjusting --go:

title: Tibble Extension for Nowcasts
text: Temporal effects can added covariates tbl_now() using [temporal_effects()][tbl_now()](https://rodrigozepeda.github.io/tbl.now/reference/temporal_effects.html). example can specify includes day week, week year, whether holiday US: effects can added tbl_now() object add_temporal_effects() function: Note Christmas (2023-12-25) marked .event_holiday, everything corresponds first epidemiological week 2024, days week correspond Monday (event_day_of_week = 2) Tuesday (event_day_of_week = 3). effects can used covariates models.
code: t_eff <- temporal_effects(day_of_week = TRUE, week_of_year = TRUE, holidays = cal_us_federal()) t_eff #>  #> ── Temporal Effects ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> The following effects are in place: #> • "day_of_week" #> • "week_of_year" #> • "holidays": #>   1. New Year's Day, US Martin Luther King Jr. Day, US Presidents' Day, US #>   Memorial Day, US Juneteenth, US Independence Day, US Labor Day, US Indigenous #>   Peoples' Day, US Veterans Day, US Thanksgiving, and Christmas df_now %>%    add_temporal_effects(t_eff) #> # A tibble:  4 × 9 #> # Data type: "count-incidence" #> # Frequency: Event: `days` | Report: `days` #>   event_date  report_date     n .event_num .report_num .delay .event_day_of_week #>   <date>      <date>      <dbl>      <dbl>       <dbl>  <dbl>              <int> #>   [event_dat… [report_da… [...]      [...]       [...]  [...]         [t_effect] #> 1 2023-12-25  2023-12-26     10          0           1      1                  2 #> 2 2023-12-26  2023-12-26      2          1           1      0                  3 #> 3 2023-12-25  2023-12-27      5          0           2      2                  2 #> 4 2023-12-26  2023-12-27     11          1           2      1                  3 #> # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> # Now: 2023-12-27 | Event date: "event_date" | Report date: "report_date" #> # T. effects: ".event_day_of_week", ".event_week_of_year", and ".event_holiday" #> # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> # ℹ 2 more variables: .event_week_of_year <int>, .event_holiday <int>
